title: The USB-C Apple Pencil is under $50 for the first time this year
content:
Macworld

Apple Pencil USB-C

View Deal

iPad deals have been amazing this Black Friday, so if you just bought one, nothing complements your new tablet as well as an Apple Pencil. And this deal practically makes it an impulse buy: You can grab this USB-C model for just $49, which is the absolute best price we’ve ever seen for this model. That’s 38 percent ($30) under its $79 MSRP and the perfect Black Friday gift for yourself or someone you really like.

The Apple Pencil pairs up with your iPad in a blink, and you can use it for writing, drawing, signing off on documents, or sketching with ease. It feels like writing on paper, and the pixel-perfect precision makes it ideal for anyone passionate about drawing, whether professionally or as a hobby. There are tons of apps in the store that will be instantly better once you add this Pencil to your setup.

Since it has a USB-C port, it’s super easy to recharge anytime you need it. Plus, it snaps magnetically to the side of your iPad for easy storage, so you can ensure you won’t lose it between the couch pillows. It works with a wide range of older iPads too, including. the 10th-gen iPad, 6th-gen and A17 Pro iPad mini, and numerous iPad Air and iPad Pro models going back several generations. You can even use this Pencil with the iPhone Duo if you’re lucky enough to get one.

Since this is the more affordable Apple Pencil model, know that it has no pressure sensitivity, so lines won’t get thicker when you press harder. It also doesn’t charge wirelessly, which is why the C-port is there. But for $49, it’s one of the absolute steals this Black Friday.
